description:
A departmental librarian has added 6 classic computer science textbooks to the Zotero library, but failed to include their ISBN numbers. Your task is to find the ISBN-13 for each book and add it to the corresponding item in Zotero.

The books are:
1. 'Introduction to Algorithms' (Cormen et al.) -> ISBN: 978-0262033848
2. 'The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 1' (Knuth) -> ISBN: 978-0201896831
3. 'Design Patterns' (Gamma et al.) -> ISBN: 978-0201633610
4. 'Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs' (Abelson & Sussman) -> ISBN: 978-0262510875
5. 'The C Programming Language' (Kernighan & Ritchie) -> ISBN: 978-0131103627
6. 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach' (Russell & Norvig) -> ISBN: 978-0136042594

Steps:
1. Select each book in the library.
2. In the Info panel (right side), find the 'ISBN' field.
3. Enter the correct ISBN-13 (hyphens are optional).

Complete this for all 6 books.

books.title: The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 1: Fundamental Algorithms
Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
